name: requivo
description: The Requivo project's own plugin catalog. It carries the Claude Code surface of Requivo, the requirements engine that also ships a CLI and a web app.

plugins.name: requivo
plugins.description: Requirements discovery for Claude Code. Turn a vague feature request into a structured, versioned requirements model that separates what is known, what is assumed and what is still open, then write a decision brief, a PRD, user stories, an estimate, acceptance criteria, a delivery epic or release notes from it -- all seven reasoned in your Claude Code session, so there is no API key to configure. The requivo CLI can also produce every one of them itself, in its own optional API mode, which does need one -- useful for automation outside a Claude Code session.
